text:
ryan: Hey team — after the private deployment upgrade yesterday our collector (collector-agent v2.4.1) is failing to upload debug bundles to the presign endpoint. Customer reports higher tail latency on inference and a billing spike from repeated upload retries. I grabbed one request id from the collector log: req=R-0a1b2c3d upload_id=up-20260316T184512Z. Can someone advise repro steps we can run from the customer box?

jamie: thanks, ryan. Can you paste the exact collector command they ran and the manifest checksum if available? Also we need a curl reproduction against the presigned URL (don't share the real public URL in this channel, use DM or redacted). Typical repro curl I ask for: 
```
curl -v -X PUT "<PRESIGNED_URL>" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/octet-stream" \n  --upload-file bundle.tar.gz
```
If that returns 403 we want the raw response headers (x-amz-request-id, x-amz-id-2) and the collector stderr.

marta: quick log excerpt from the collector the customer pasted (redacted):
```
2026-03-16T18:45:12Z ERROR upload presign request failed status=403 req=R-0a1b2c3d msg="presign returned 403: AccessDenied"
2026-03-16T18:45:12Z DEBUG s3 resp-header x-amz-request-id=KJH12345TP x-amz-id-2=some-long-id
2026-03-16T18:45:12Z WARN retrying upload attempt=3 backoff=2s
```
Looks like the presign call itself is being rejected, not the PUT to the presigned URL. Could be stale agent credentials or clock skew on the VM used to call the control plane.

lee: repro checklist I recommend we ask the customer to run (in order):
1) collector version and args: `collector --version` and the systemd unit / service args.
2) regenerate a debug bundle locally: `collector gather --output bundle.tar.gz --include-logs --redact=default --verbose` (attach bundle manifest.json and sha256).
3) compute checksum: `sha256sum bundle.tar.gz` and post the first 8 chars + full sha if comfortable.
4) attempt presign + upload using curl (if presign issued by our control plane):
```
# request presign from control plane (customer does this via their UI or CLI)
# then from the collector host:
curl -v -X PUT "<PRESIGNED_URL>" -H "Content-Type: application/octet-stream" --upload-file bundle.tar.gz 2>&1 | tee upload.log
```
If the curl shows a 403, paste the upload.log. If curl succeeds locally but collector still fails, paste collector verbose logs.

jamie: also ask them to run `date -u` on the collector host and confirm within ~5s of NTP — AWS-signed presigns are sensitive to clock skew. If their VM clock is >1 minute off we'll see signature failures.

marta: another thing I saw in a previous private deployment issue — when a customer rotates their KMS key or the control plane's service account token expired, presign generation returns 403. We should ask the customer to confirm no recent KMS or credential rotations. If they did rotate, we may need to re-provision a short-lived agent token.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Created temp presign endpoint for support repro (ttl=1h) — do NOT share the raw URL in channel.

lee: extra troubleshooting commands we sometimes ask the customer to run (safe to paste):
```
# debug upload with headers shown
curl -v -X PUT "<PRESIGNED_URL>" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/octet-stream" \n  -H "x-amz-meta-collector: collector-01" \n  --upload-file bundle.tar.gz |& tee put-debug.log
# check manifest checksum locally
sha256sum bundle.tar.gz | awk '{print $1}' > bundle.sha256
# collector collect debug (bundles only)
collector collect --include=logs,system,svc-config --redact=pii --out /tmp/debug-bundle.tar.gz --verbose
```

ryan: I'll ask the customer to run those and gather: collector args, `date -u`, bundle.tar.gz (if they can share via SFTP or support presign), sha256, upload.log, and collector verbose output. Also I asked them to confirm no recent KMS/token rotations.

jamie: once they upload the bundle, please DM the presign URL to me or attach via the private support upload. We will: (a) check the manifest.json for redaction failures, (b) verify the checksum and re-run a PUT to the presign from a support host, (c) inspect control-plane audit logs for the request id R-0a1b2c3d, and (d) if needed create a one-off short-lived agent token and patch the collector config to test.

marta: for billing spike root cause — frequent retry loops from the collector can create duplicate small uploads or meter repeated presign attempts. Once we have the logs we can count retry loops and propose a fix (back off config or stop-gap policy to disable auto-upload).

ryan: got it. I'll send a clear checklist to the customer. Thanks — I'll post the upload.log and bundle.sha256 here when they finish. :thumbsup:

jamie: great. next steps from us: if we confirm presign 403 caused by expired creds or KMS, escalate to infra (I will ping @marta and @infra on-call) and we will coordinate a temporary presign and test upload from our side. If it's clock skew we'll instruct the customer to enable NTP and retry.

lee: one more note — if the collector redaction is failing and manifest indicates un-redacted IPs, we may reject upload server-side; include manifest.json in the bundle so we can rule that out early.

ryan: thanks team — will update thread when customer posts artifacts. :thumbsup:
